intent: Group a card's title, description and optional corner action into the block at its top.
typical_uses: The top block of a Card holding its title, its description and one action beside them

dont_use_when.situation: The top block of a placeholder for a region with nothing to show
The title block of a modal dialog

invariants.text: CardHeader is a grid spaced var(--space-1) apart that switches layout on which parts are its direct children: a direct CardAction adds a second, content-sized column for the action, and a direct CardDescription gives the grid two rows, title then description. There is no prop for either; a part wrapped in another element is not detected.

good.title: Title, description and a corner action

bad.title: The text parts wrapped in an extra element
bad.why: The header looks for CardDescription among its direct children only, so the wrapped description does not get its own grid row; the wrapper also puts a non-part element into the header.
